correctness.rationale: Legendre formula exactly gives ν3(T_n)=(s_3(2u-1)-1)/2 with u=(n+1)/3^ν3(n+1). Partitioning 1..3^m by primitive u yields V_m=1+Σ_{L<=m} A_L. The units digit and 2-state carry matrix M(x)=[[1+x²,x],[x,1+x²]], initial row (x,1) and terminal (1,x)^T give A1=2,A2=3+3q and Cayley-Hamilton A_{L+2}=2(1+q)A_{L+1}-(1+q+q²)A_L. Summation gives ((1-qz)^2)/((1-z)(1-2(1+q)z+(1+q+q²)z²)). Pole-order extraction at z=1 gives fixed-j asymptotic m^(2j+2)/(2j+2)!; leading coefficients of A_L yield max valuation m-1 multiplicity m+1 for m>=2. Independently calculated exact T_n valuations on prefixes m=1..6, matching all recurrence coefficient vectors, e.g. m6 [28,140,267,216,71,7].
